name: Flow Fish Loop
aim: Let a visitor press arrow keys to steer the cat to the fish.
reason: Playable, runs with no errors, one joke told.

sessions.caption: The still frame moves: a cat chases a fish head, one arrow at a time, on a timer. No errors.
Now playable: the screen demands one arrow, the cat steps, wrong arrows get judged, fish get eaten. Buttons too.
Checked the loop: arrows steer the cat, no errors. Fish still get eaten, still judged.
